title: Vendor whisper.cpp + OpenBLAS CMake build + Rust FFI wiring
description:
Goal
- Vendor and wire whisper.cpp as a shared library (`libwhisper.so`) with system OpenBLAS, exposed through layered Rust FFI (`whisper_sys`) and safe API (`whisper_rs`).

Scope
- CMake build via Cargo `build.rs` using `cmake` crate
- System OpenBLAS resolution via pkg-config/CMake
- Bindgen wrapper generation from `whisper.h`
- GTK wiring for startup system info + model load smoke path
- Linkage/runtime validation

Acceptance Criteria
- `cargo clean && cargo build` succeeds on a machine with OpenBLAS installed
- Resulting binary runs and prints Whisper system info
- Smoke test can load model and cleanly free context
- `ldd target/debug/<binary>` shows linkage to `libopenblas.so`
close_reason: All child beads complete and acceptance criteria validated

title: Add FFmpeg-backed audio format support (Opus/AAC)
description:
Goal
- Enable FFmpeg integration in whisper.cpp so Voxpipe can ingest additional audio formats (e.g., Opus and AAC).

Background
- whisper.cpp supports broader format decoding when built with `WHISPER_FFMPEG=yes`.

Prerequisites
- Debian/Ubuntu:
  `sudo apt install libavcodec-dev libavformat-dev libavutil-dev`
- RHEL/Fedora:
  `sudo dnf install libavcodec-free-devel libavformat-free-devel libavutil-free-devel`

Build Requirements
- Enable FFmpeg in CMake build config:
  `cmake -B build -D WHISPER_FFMPEG=yes`
  `cmake --build build`
- Integrate equivalent flag into Voxpipe Cargo/CMake flow (`build.rs` + vendor CMake args), not just manual local builds.

Validation Scenario
- Convert test WAV to Opus:
  `ffmpeg -i samples/jfk.wav jfk.opus`
- Verify transcription works:
  `./build/bin/whisper-cli --model models/ggml-base.en.bin --file jfk.opus`

Deliverables
- Build system support for FFmpeg-enabled whisper.cpp builds
- Documentation updates for required FFmpeg dev packages per distro
- Runtime smoke validation for at least Opus input

Acceptance Criteria
1. Voxpipe build can enable whisper.cpp FFmpeg support through project build config
2. Opus input transcription succeeds in validation workflow
3. Missing FFmpeg dependency errors are actionable in docs/output
4. README/build docs include distro-specific package requirements
